about: Packed words, lower case and every form of the tool word: T0 deselects and is no tool change, T1=5 and T2="PARTOFF" are the tools of numbered spindles, and S2= is that spindle's speed, not the plain S; S1= is the main spindle's speed (spindle 1, addresses.mainSpindle), and so the speed in force (M10 P10, the owner's reading of 2026-09-27; until M10 it was not).

states.about: M10 P10: S1=900 names the main spindle.
S2=600 is spindle 2's, so the speed in force stays the main spindle's.
